exact_items: Contracts_V0.md is the correct owner for the canonical route contract.
Crosswalk.md is the correct owner for the primitive boundary declaration.
storage-plan.md is a consumer of navigation identity, not the owner of it.

The clean owner split is: Contracts_V0.md owns route_target and OpenSubject; Crosswalk.md declares a primitive boundary for route-target / subject-open navigation; storage-plan.md owns persisted refs and projections that store navigation-related fields such as resume_url.

seed_candidates.canon_label_hint: surface docs reference route contract boundary
exact_items: FinalGUISpec.md, FileManager.md, and UI_Command_Catalog.md are also consumers. They should reference the route contract and the primitive boundary instead of restating them.
The command catalog / command contract layer owns normalization metadata; the route contract owns route-target structure; the wiring matrix owns UI element to command/handler binding only.
Deprecated alias metadata should remain explicit and separate because it implies lifecycle/removal expectations that wrapper commands do not have.
Extend GATE-010 to verify: deprecated aliases resolve to real canonical command IDs.

seed_candidates.canon_label_hint: small normalization contract wiring gate boundary
exact_items: The normalization contract needs to stay deliberately small.
It should NOT inline route payload shape, object kinds, or argument mapping rules into the command metadata.

The wiring layer should stay mostly unchanged. It already keys off ui_command_id and handler location. The important addition is gate logic that can understand the normalization metadata, not a large wiring-schema expansion.
Keep wiring schema expansion minimal or zero if possible.
